reports.title: RUSH ENTERPRISES, INC. REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS,

lines: ACT Research forecasts U.S. retail sales of new Class 8 trucks to total 229,400 units in 2026, a 7.8% increase compared to 2025.
ACT Research forecasts U.S. retail sales for new Class 4 through 7 commercial vehicles to be approximately 218,575 units in 2026, an increase of 0.5% compared to 2025.
